routeSummary: Argentina → Chile → Bolivia → Rio → Paraty → Rio → Iguaçu → Rio → Cartagena → Medellín → Bogotá
criticalAlert: 11 Oct: group split in Rio — Niki flies BA248 to London; Sahil, Priyesh and Amisha take AV146 to Bogotá, then connect onward to Cartagena.

2026-10-06.title: Rio → Paraty
2026-10-06.intro: Final Rio morning, then the Costa Verde road to Paraty for two nights.
2026-10-06.anchor: Private road transfer to Paraty; historic centre in the evening.

evening: Paraty Historic Centre, dinner and cachaça.

2026-10-06.watchOut: Allow 4–5 hours and Rio traffic buffer.

2026-10-07.title: Paraty · Mamanguá
2026-10-07.intro: Full Paraty day: fjord-like water, jungle and swim stops.
2026-10-07.anchor: Saco do Mamanguá boat day, flexed around weather and energy.

morning: Early boat toward Saco do Mamanguá.
afternoon: Swim / beach / optional Pico hike; return before dark.
eat: Local caiçara food with non-seafood alternatives.
logistics: Keep the boat operator flexible for weather.

2026-10-07.watchOut: Flex the boat plan for sea/weather.

2026-10-08.title: Paraty → Rio
2026-10-08.intro: Slow Paraty morning, then back to Rio for one reset night.

logistics: Rio reset night between Paraty and Iguaçu.

2026-10-08.watchOut: Keep the evening flexible for road traffic.

2026-10-09.title: Rio → Iguaçu · Argentina side
2026-10-09.intro: Fly early from Rio and spend the day on the Argentine side of the falls.
2026-10-09.anchor: Early GIG → IGU, then the Argentine circuits; sleep in Foz.

morning: Early nonstop GIG → IGU; transfer to the Argentine side.
afternoon: Argentine falls circuits and Devil’s Throat access if operating.
evening: Return to Foz, easy dinner and early night.
logistics: Carry passports for the border crossing.

2026-10-09.watchOut: Protect the early flight and border-transfer time.
2026-10-09.sleepText: Foz do Iguaçu - one night, 9 Oct.

2026-10-10.title: Iguaçu → Rio
2026-10-10.intro: Brazilian side in the morning, optional Macuco, then back to Rio for Saturday night.
2026-10-10.anchor: Brazilian falls + optional Macuco; target the ~18:15 IGU → GIG flight.

morning: Macuco Safari if wanted and timings work.
afternoon: Head to IGU with buffer; target ~18:15 IGU → GIG.
evening: Land Rio and enjoy the final Saturday night together.
eat: Final Rio dinner depending on arrival time.
logistics: Sleep Rio so 11 Oct is an easy departure day.

2026-10-10.watchOut: Do not compromise the Brazilian side, but avoid the last flight of the night.

2026-10-11.intro: Easy Rio morning, then all four head to GIG together: Niki to London; Sahil, Priyesh and Amisha to Bogotá and onward Cartagena.
2026-10-11.anchor: Niki: BA248 GIG → London ~16:45. Trio: AV146 GIG → Bogotá ~16:40, then onward Cartagena.

morning: Easy Rio breakfast / lunch and final packing.
afternoon: All four head to GIG together.
Sahil + Priyesh + Amisha: AV146 to Bogotá (~16:40).
evening: Trio connect Bogotá → Cartagena the same evening; exact onward flight to confirm.
eat: Keep food functional around airport timings.
logistics: Niki leaves the trip in Rio on 11 Oct.

rule.title: Connection discipline
rule.text: Treat 11 Oct AV146 → Bogotá → Cartagena clinically: hand luggage where possible, realistic connection buffer, online check-in, pre-arranged Cartagena transfer, hotel booked from 11 Oct, and live recheck before payment.
